figurative_meaning_en: To scold or express disapproval by distorting one's face
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মুখ খিঁচিয়ে বলল, 'এভাবে খাবি না।'
মা মুখ খিঁচানো করে ছেলেকে ধমক দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: She made a face and said, 'Don't eat like that.'
The mother scolded her son by pulling a face.
note: Commonly used in informal Bengali speech to convey mild rebuke through facial gestures.
